notes: Adds GET /api/reviews/status?page=... - a new public endpoint the site calls to decide whether to show the 'leave a review' prompt on one specific page, since the server can't otherwise know what page a caller is on. Recognizes 4 pages for now: ticket_reply, order_status, refill, dashboard (unknown values are rejected). Each page has its own on/off toggle on Reviews > Settings, on top of the existing master switch - turning the master switch off overrides every page's toggle. All 4 pages default to enabled. Response: {ok, page, show_prompt}. No database changes.
